# Dalang Web

> Dalang Web is the browser version of Dalang, a tool for Dungeon Masters
> running a Dungeons & Dragons campaign. Prep the world, house rules,
> locations, NPCs, and a job board; run the session with a live battle map,
> tokens, initiative, and fog of war; and hand players one read-only link
> that shows the current scene, live, with no sign-in for players. Campaigns
> are saved to your account and open from any browser. Free during the
> public beta, every feature included.

- App: https://app.dalang.page
- Desktop version: https://bukanpawkemon.itch.io/dalang-campaign-dashboard
- User guide: https://guide.dalang.page
- Source and issues: https://github.com/BukanPawkemon/Campaign-Dashboard

## Free plan (during beta)

- 2 campaigns
- Per campaign: 40 NPCs, 25 locations, 40 jobs, 8 players, 250 log entries
- 25 homebrew entries, 1 saved adventure
- Every feature. Nothing is locked behind a payment. Higher limits are planned for later.

## Key facts

- Runs entirely in the browser, nothing to install.
- Players open a shared link with no account; they never see DM notes, secrets, encounters, or treasure.
- Rules content: the D&D System Reference Document, 5.1 (2014) and 5.2 (2024). Homebrew monsters, magic items, and equipment are supported.
- A campaign exports to a file and moves between Dalang Web and Dalang Desktop in either direction.
- Not a full virtual tabletop: there is a live battle map for combat, but the focus is prepping and running the whole campaign.
